headline: The documented round-down rule reproduces the four gold disputes exactly; the only defect is that the rounding doc is missing from required_documents.

issues.summary: The floor-rounding policy doc that decides which transactions are discrepant (doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_007) is not listed in required_documents, so the golden_retrieval config, which inlines only required_documents and exposes no search tool, never shows it to the agent.
evidence: doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_007: "All credit card rewards points are rounded down to the nearest whole number. When calculating points earned on a purchase, the system always truncates (floors) fractional points rather than rounding to the nearest integer."
src/tau2/domains/banking_knowledge/retrieval_toolkits.py: KnowledgeToolsPlain 'Used by: no_knowledge, full_kb, golden_retrieval' (no retrieval tools)
issues.why_it_matters: In the golden_retrieval config, half-up rounding flags 11 extra transactions (for example txn_f2a3b4c5d6e7, Sprouts $112.58 x 5 = 562.9: 563 vs stored 562) and fails.

solution_check: Recomputed all 23 transactions for af0581dcbf with Gold 2.5% flat and EcoCard 5x Green else 1x, flooring per doc_007. Exactly four mismatch, matching the gold: Thrive Market 875 vs 175, Uber 600 vs 240, Tentree 1000 vs 600, Nordstrom 800 vs 775. Half-up gives 15 mismatches (11 false positives). Both accounts were opened in 2024, so no new-customer promo applies.
prior_note: The prior Major ('unwritten round down') is overturned: doc_007 documents floor rounding. What remains is a Minor required_documents omission.
notes: The v1.0.1 change to doc_credit_cards_gold_rewards_card_001 is cosmetic ('$105 days' -> '105 days'); 'Minimum credit score required: $720' is still corrupted but irrelevant here. Thrive Market is an online membership marketplace; ecocard_003 says 'Marketplaces and delivery platforms may process payments through non-green parent entities; in those cases, the purchase may not qualify.' The DB category is 'Green', so the category-based reading (5x, dispute) is the natural one, but a cautious agent could hesitate on this row.
